register.labelZh: FLUSH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: flush out 可以描述狗隻、聲音、光線或其他行動把藏起來的人或動物趕離藏身處。；雨水、溪水或流動的水把塵埃、樹葉、泥土或其他鬆散物質沖走時,可以使用 flush away。；用水把水管、瓶子、水缸或其他物件裏的污垢、沙粒、肥皂或舊液體沖出來時,可以使用 flush out。；這些表達可以出現在清潔、供水系統、大自然和日常安全指示中。
register.summaryEn: Flush out can describe dogs, noise, light or another action making a hidden animal or person leave a place. Flush away is useful when rain, a stream or flowing water removes dust, leaves, mud or other loose material. Flush out can describe using water to remove dirt, sand, soap or old liquid from a pipe, bottle, tank or similar object. These expressions can appear in instructions about cleaning, water systems, nature and everyday safety.
